title: intake's drift checks end their whole process tree on a timeout and catch whole-suite runs behind a wrapper
goal: A drift check that times out, or is running when the hook exits, has its whole process group ended (tests.py, uv, pytest and its xdist workers), and heavy_check also refuses a whole-suite run reached through sh -c, a wrapper such as perfcheck.py or a -k 'not ...' selector; tests plant a check whose grandchild outlives a timeout and each wrapper form
notes: Sprint review of SP-3brmvlnh: check_result kills only its direct child, so a timed-out tests.py leaves uv run pytest -n auto with parent pid 1.
